title: The N-2 assertion for a power series ring
statement: Let R be a Noetherian integral domain which is N-2. Then the one-variable power series ring R[[x]] is N-2.

proof.text: Take the integral closure R' of R in its fraction field. The N-2 hypothesis makes R' finite over R; it is Noetherian, normal, and N-2. The coefficientwise generators make R'[[x]] finite over R[[x]]. Tate's complete-principal criterion applied to x, using the quotient R' and x-adic completeness, gives that R'[[x]] is N-2. Descent along the finite domain extension R[[x]] ⊂ R'[[x]] gives the result.
